text_block_list.text:
We had just returned from
an outing with Silence Suzuka, but—
I get the feeling someone is staring very intently this way...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer-san.
Would it be alright if I dropped by the trainer's office?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm... not like that.
Trainer should go first...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'll... follow along later.
Please go on ahead.

As Silence Suzuka told me to,
I waited in the Trainer's room, and—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Please wait.
Don't look this way just yet...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —Yes, I'm alright now.
When I turn around—

On the desk sat a snow globe just like
the one won from the arcade before.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Umâ

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: This time, I was able to win it entirely on my own.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The snowy landscape... that I love so much.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Look, it lights up when you flip the switch.
Powder snow swirls around inside, and it's just so pretty...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Somehow, it feels just like
the scenery from where I was born and raised—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "So, um... well. Uhm..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: How... would that be...?
choice_data_list: The snow back in your hometown is beautiful too, huh.
The snow back in your hometown is beautiful too, isn't it?
Can I try flipping the switch?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: How... would that be...?
choice_data_list: The snow back in your hometown is beautiful too, huh.
The snow back in your hometown is beautiful too, isn't it?
Can I try flipping the switch?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, it feels like...
my body has become so much lighter.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufufu—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Right now, I really... want to start running.

Matching snow globes,
gifted to me by Silence Suzuka—
I placed the tiny snowscape in a prominent spot in my room.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!
That's right.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Pure white, serene, and seemingly drawing me in—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
When I run, it feels so amazing.
...Like I could keep running forever.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Forever, and ever, for all eternity...
I found myself wishing this scenery would last forever.
choice_data_list: I'd love to see it someday.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I think with you, Trainer...
the view would be even more beautiful.

Watching the light flurry of snow—
I shared a quiet conversation with Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, absolutely.
(*Click—*)
The snow globe glows, and powdered snow swirls around the two snowmen.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It really is so beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah...

"One of the snowmen toppled over with a plop,
leaning against the snowman beside it."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...She ended up falling, didn't she?
choice_data_list: Even though Suzuka went out of her way to give it to me...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Um, shall we trade with mine?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Because if they huddle up like this,
they won't feel lonely either."

Afterward, I traded it for the snow globe
that had belonged to Silence Suzuka.

She happily took home the two little snowmen
snuggled together in their tiny snowy scene.
